import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_95/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length2_95/training_1.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Rename columns in df0 to match join keys with df1
# df0 has 'name' for school name, df1 has 'school' for school name
# Join on df0.name == df1.school
df0_renamed = df0.rename(columns={'name': 'School Name', 'size': 'School Size', 'budget': 'School Budget', 'type': 'School Type'})

# df1 columns: ['Student ID', 'name', 'gender', 'grade', 'school', 'reading_score', 'math_score']
# Rename df1 columns to match target schema naming conventions
df1_renamed = df1.rename(columns={
    'grade': 'Student Grade',
    'school': 'School Name',
    'reading_score': 'Student Reading Score',
    'math_score': 'Math Score'
})

# Join df0 and df1 on School Name
df_joined = pd.merge(df0_renamed, df1_renamed, on='School Name', how='inner')

# Group by School ID and Student Grade, aggregate as specified:
# first(School Name), first(School Size), first(School Budget),
# first(Student ID), first(Student Reading Score), avg(Math Score)
agg_df = df_joined.groupby(['School ID', 'Student Grade'], as_index=False).agg({
    'School Name': 'first',
    'School Size': 'first',
    'School Budget': 'first',
    'Student ID': 'first',
    'Student Reading Score': 'first',
    'Math Score': 'mean'
})

# Rename 'Math Score' to 'Average Student Math Score' to match target schema
agg_df = agg_df.rename(columns={'Math Score': 'Average Student Math Score'})

# Ensure column order and types as per target schema:
# ['School Name': string, 'Student Grade': string, 'School ID': integer, 'School Size': integer,
#  'School Budget': integer, 'Student ID': float, 'Student Reading Score': float, 'Average Student Math Score': float]

agg_df = agg_df[[
    'School Name',
    'Student Grade',
    'School ID',
    'School Size',
    'School Budget',
    'Student ID',
    'Student Reading Score',
    'Average Student Math Score'
]]

# Cast columns to correct types
agg_df['School Name'] = agg_df['School Name'].astype(str)
agg_df['Student Grade'] = agg_df['Student Grade'].astype(str)
agg_df['School ID'] = agg_df['School ID'].astype(int)
agg_df['School Size'] = agg_df['School Size'].astype(int)
agg_df['School Budget'] = agg_df['School Budget'].astype(int)
agg_df['Student ID'] = agg_df['Student ID'].astype(float)
agg_df['Student Reading Score'] = agg_df['Student Reading Score'].astype(float)
agg_df['Average Student Math Score'] = agg_df['Average Student Math Score'].astype(float)

# Write the final dataframe to the target path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_95/target_multisource.csv"
agg_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
